responsibility: This is the primary SPARC machine description file. It defines SPARC unspec codes, hard-register constants, mode iterators, instruction attributes, and the bulk of instruction patterns, expanders, splitters, and assembly templates for integer, floating-point, VIS, control-flow, addressing, and ABI-specific operations, and it includes sync.md for atomic patterns; together with sparc.cc it is the core specification translating GCC RTL into SPARC instructions.
same_name_distinction: This file is the machine-description source for SPARC instruction patterns, attributes, iterators, unspec codes, and assembly templates, unlike sparc.cc which contains hand-written backend logic, sparc.h which provides C preprocessor configuration macros, and sparc.opt which defines option metadata.
